remarks: Discover the Massive potential of this 1929 Spanish fixer-upper ready for its next chapter. First time on the market over 30 years, with a nice grassy flat backyard to enjoy. This old Spanish has a basement as well. .. just like in the old days. Conveniently located in the heart of the highly desirable Pico-Robertson neighborhood with 3-bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,746 sq. ft. of living space, this property offers a blank slate for your creative vision. Garage in the backyard has been converted to a living area with a bathroom NOT included in the square footage.
